attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) and node2 (OPNsense) as back-to-back routers connecting lan-a (node3) and lan-b (node4) across a transit network, with default-deny forwarding on both routers and a single explicit allow for node3 -> node4 tcp/8080 (HTTP). Verified the allowed path works end-to-end and all other cross-network traffic (ping, other ports) is refused. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all four nodes with captured boot-identity change and post-restart recovery proof, including detecting and fixing a non-persistent /tmp-based HTTP service on node4 that did not survive its reboot.
